name: rebuilt-motion
title: Rebuilt Motion
description: Custom-built motion primitives for expressive marketing surfaces without distracting from content.
useWhen: You need a restrained motion layer that reinforces hierarchy or communicates change.
avoidWhen: Motion would compete with reading, reduce clarity, or carry essential information by itself.
responsiveBehavior: Motion surfaces clip safely, adapt their columns, and remain readable at narrow widths.
accessibility: All content remains available without animation.
Animations pause or simplify for reduced-motion preferences.

variants.title: Marquee
variants.description: A clean continuous rail for short announcements or trusted signals with a calm visual rhythm.
accessibility: Duplicate content must be hidden from assistive technology and motion must be optional.

variants.title: Bento grid
variants.description: An asymmetrical feature grid that creates hierarchy through span, whitespace, and restrained surfaces.
accessibility: Keep source order meaningful when the grid collapses.

variants.title: Number ticker
variants.description: A compact metric transition that keeps the final value readable and avoids noisy perpetual motion.
accessibility: Announce meaningful value changes without repeatedly interrupting assistive technology.

variants.title: Animated beam
variants.description: A directional signal that connects related nodes with a subtle, purposeful pulse.
accessibility: The relationship must remain understandable from labels and structure without the beam.

variants.title: Animated list
variants.description: A staggered list entrance that introduces content in small groups without delaying interaction.
accessibility: Do not hide list content from keyboard or assistive technology during entrance.
